title: DARPA STO Office-Wide BAA DARPA-PS-26-09
summary: STO seeks revolutionary system-level research in sensing, effects, command and control, communications, modeling, electronic and cyber operations, and human decision-making. The emphasis is on integrated operational capability across contested environments.
key_findings: STO focuses on combinations of sensing, effects, command, control, and communications.
Electronic, cyber, directed-energy, and modeling capabilities are treated as parts of integrated systems.
Human decision-making remains a design dependency even as autonomy and machine speed increase.
why_it_matters: The solicitation shows that operational advantage depends on system integration and decision architecture, not only component performance.
ftfn_relevance: Supports links among cybersecurity, communications, sensing, autonomy, and human systems.
Provides a source for tracking integration and verification constraints around advanced capabilities.
evidence_limits: The announcement describes desired research directions rather than delivered systems.
Public descriptions may omit operational details and program-specific performance requirements.
